report:
Normalization strips ASCII edge spaces/tabs and preserves interior whitespace, every logical blank line including trailing blank lines, and Unicode without normalization. CRLF and bare CR become LF. Empty input produces empty output. For NONEMPTY INPUT, add a terminating LF only if normalized output does not already end with LF; preserve existing trailing LF characters. ([Normalization](wiki/pages/normalization.md), S001)

Read one file path and emit normalized UTF-8 to stdout. Invalid UTF-8, missing files and directories exit 2 with concise stderr and no stdout. No in-place writes, stdin, size limit or external dependencies. ([Errors](wiki/pages/errors.md), S002)

The selected wiki pages do not establish roadmap dependency identities, prerequisite edges or readiness status. Recommend separate ingestion of .specify/memory/roadmap.md for that exact gap; no ingestion ran.
Relied-on pages: wiki/pages/normalization.md (S001); wiki/pages/errors.md (S002).
Coverage: Partial.
